name: Frames Integration for Farcaster
author: Davis Shaver

sections.description:
Frames Integration for Farcaster makes it easy to setup Farcaster frames meta tags for your WordPress site.

  • Enable frames for your WordPress site
  • Set button text, splash screen background color, and splash screen icon
  • Validate your Farcaster manifest config
  • Subscribe users to notifications through frames
  • Offer tipping and casting through frames

This plugin is developed in public on Github, where the source code can be accessed. Pull requests, feature ideas, and other feedback welcome.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/frames-integration-for-farcaster directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin through the ‘Farcaster Settings’ screen in the WordPress admin.

screenshots.caption: Frames Integration for Farcaster connects your WordPress site to Farcaster.
Frames Integration for Farcaster allows you to enable frames for your WordPress site and configure splash background image and splash background color.
Frames Integration for Farcaster helps you validate your Farcaster manifest file and pinpoints any differences with your WordPress site.
Frames Integration for Farcaster lets you offer site visitors easy options for tipping or casting.
Frames Integration for Farcaster offers a subscriptions feature that lets users get notified when you publish a new post.
